REGISTERED_K.unit: one frozen claim ID = one registered hypothesis/test

WHAT_IS_ONE_TEST.explicit: the same token pair at a different position pair is NOT merged

K_IS_NOT_REDUCED_BY_CLUSTERING.RULE: clustering and correlation do NOT reduce the registered k
K_IS_NOT_REDUCED_BY_CLUSTERING.FORBIDDEN_REASONING: 20,751 raw claims -> highly correlated -> effective k = 2,500

correct_separation.dependency_and_clustering: handled later as STATISTICAL TREATMENT; never rewrites the registered k

non_equivalences: graph cluster count != a replacement for k
K_IS_NOT_REDUCED_BY_CLUSTERING.why_it_matters_here: these claims share source features heavily, so a cluster-count substitution would be especially tempting and especially wrong

ONE_FAMILY_ONLY.FORBIDDEN: post-hoc splitting into subfamilies each carrying its own smaller k
ONE_FAMILY_ONLY.permitted: position and type breakdowns as DIAGNOSTICS only — never a reason to restart the correction

NON_SEARCHABLE_CLAIMS.retention: kept in the audit registry with reason codes
NON_SEARCHABLE_CLAIMS.RULE: real Y must NOT be computed on them within this family's search

NO_RESURRECTION.forbidden: reviving a support-failed claim because Y later looks interesting

DIAGNOSTICS_DO_NOT_ALTER_MEMBERSHIP.basis: both metrics were prespecified as NON-EXCLUSION diagnostics before any distribution was seen

FROZEN_LINEAGE.purpose: every future statistic has exactly ONE frozen search universe to refer to

IMMUTABILITY.only_exception: a discovered TECHNICAL DEFECT, handled by an EXPLICIT amendment or requalification artifact — never a silent membership edit
IMMUTABILITY.absolutely_forbidden: after seeing Y, dropping a claim on the grounds that it 'resembles another one'

NEXT_GATE.rule: do NOT proceed to real Y after this freeze
NEXT_GATE.then: SYNTHETIC-Y SMOKE (validates plumbing; requires the statistical contract to already exist)
